queries.name: attention_concentration
queries.query: (ti:"attention concentration" OR abs:"attention concentration" OR ti:"attention collapse" OR abs:"attention collapse" OR ti:"entropy collapse" OR abs:"entropy collapse" OR ti:"attention saturation" OR abs:"attention saturation" OR ti:"attention entropy" OR abs:"attention entropy" OR ti:"attention hotspot" OR abs:"attention hotspot" OR ti:"attention hot spots" OR abs:"attention hot spots") AND (cat:cs.LG OR cat:cs.CL OR cat:cs.CV OR cat:cs.AI OR cat:stat.ML) AND submittedDate:[202601010000 TO 202610262359]

limits: A complete retrieved page set is not exhaustive coverage of the research field.
OpenAlex citation edges and full-text title hits are separate signals. Indexed mentions are not represented as verified citations.
Citation-only and keyword-only entries are included with unassigned method labels until the scientific content is read.
Persistent sink behavior, low per-query entropy, and low-rank or smoothed attention are related but distinct measurements.
Identifiers and exact normalized titles drive deduplication. Different-title publication versions can remain unresolved.
OpenAlex dates and document types are inherited metadata, not independently verified publication claims.
The 60 primary reference checks are a newest-arXiv convenience batch, not a representative sample.

reading_note.limits: The tested failures are controlled low-precision training faults. The study does not establish persistent semantic-independent sink positions in all models, and a large QK norm alone is not a sufficient failure detector.
reading_note.taxonomy_note: Retained as broader concentration/stability evidence. Existing attention-sink method categories are not inferred from QK normalization alone.

records.date_basis: arXiv first submitted, UTC

reading_note.finding: The paper diagnoses BLOOM heads with BOS mass and attention entropy, then reinitializes selected Q/K/V projections, zeroes their output projections, and trains them while masking gradients of the remaining parameters.
reading_note.relevance: Directly relevant to BOS concentration and post-training repair. A concrete example of model adaptation that reduces a learned attention pathology.
reading_note.limits: Full repair is evaluated only on BLOOM-1b7. Head-recovery thresholds are architecture-dependent, corpus effects remain confounded, and generation evaluation is limited.
reading_note.taxonomy_note: Relevant to Other Mitigation Techniques and Model Tuning; any future formal row should retain that training is required rather than describe it as a training-free edit.

records.date_basis: arXiv first submitted, UTC

reading_note.finding: TQL measures increasingly concentrated attention in larger Transformer Q-functions and trains with attention-entropy losses using adaptive layer-wise and VALUE-token coefficients.
reading_note.relevance: Broadens the concentration discussion to reinforcement-learning value networks and provides evidence on entropy-guided training interventions.
reading_note.limits: The experiments concern small offline-RL critics and do not show that their concentrated tokens implement the same mechanisms as LLM sinks. Entropy regularization, modality embeddings, and policy extraction contribute to the evaluated system.
reading_note.taxonomy_note: Retained as related entropy-control evidence. The learnable entropy coefficient is not an attention-logit bias and is not a learnable sink token.
